conviction_note: Near-zero: the 17-month period is visibly landing a few percent short of the May-cut OP plan (public arithmetic, priced), the real event is the first 12-month guide (FY2027.8) against a stale mid-term target of OP 5,190 before the Kokoronet consolidation, which the run-rate cannot reach. July deaths turned up and a progressive dividend sets a floor. Netted: abs 3.0 (above the 1.75 proxy because this print carries a new-year guide and the name's actual print reactions run at a median of about 2.4%), p_up 48 after LESSONS rule 1; impact_sum -0.25 and the scaled -0.12 agree in sign and size.
bar: Company 17-month (2025-04-01 to 2026-08-31) plan revised 2026-05-15: revenue 59,300m, OP 4,200m, ordinary 4,040m, NP 4,520m, dividend 57 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260515536333.pdf; reaffirmed 2026-08-14 in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260814/140120260814520221.pdf). For the new year, the only sourced bar is the mid-term plan's FY2026 (Sep 2026-Aug 2027) target of revenue 46,900m / OP 5,190m, set 2025-08-14 BEFORE the Kokoronet consolidation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250814/140120250814541516.pdf). No 四季報 or IFIS number could be sourced (shikiho online is a JS shell), so the guide findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: no disclosed position >=0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0) per baseline (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 9.96x on kabutan 2026-10-15 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9628), a crowded margin long, which is the one setup where a disappointing guide still finds sellers. No options, no skew. Run-up +4.4% over 20 sessions, +3.0% over 5. The company's 500m buyback (May 18 - Oct 31 window) completed on 2026-07-30, so that bid is gone (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260803/140120260803506444.pdf).

findings.finding: The 17-month period should land slightly short of the May-revised plan on OP and clearly short on revenue. Through 15 months (to 2026-06-30) revenue is 49,041m (82.7% of 59,300) and OP 3,638m (86.6% of 4,200), so Jul-Aug needs revenue of 10,259m (about 5.1bn a month, against Q5's 3.7bn a month including Kokoronet) and OP of 562m (against 645m for the whole of Jul-Sep 2025 before Kokoronet). Expect OP around 4,050-4,150 (-1 to -4%) and revenue around 56.5bn (-4 to -5%), while NP beats (already 4,705 vs 4,520, on a provisional 2,810m negative-goodwill gain).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q5 (2026-08-14, underlying weakness visible in the quarter): -3.85% the next session. Q3 (2026-02-13, OP down 10% in Oct-Dec): -2.47%. H1 (2025-11-14): -5.20%. The May 2026 35% OP cut was bought at +2.42% (bad news out, plus a buyback). Closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9628.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: anyone can do this from the Q5 短信 and the stock fell 3.85% on that release. What is left is the size of the revenue shortfall (about 5%), which the company has not acknowledged. It is below the 10% threshold for a 差異 notice, so no pre-release came. A priced shortfall would show up as a flat-to-down drift since Aug 14, and the stock is down from 1,428 to 1,337.
findings.independence: Quarterly OP history from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9628): Jul-Sep 2025 at 645m is the seasonal low. That is the same company data, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: This release must carry the first 12-month guide on the new August year end (FY2027.8). The only company bar is the mid-term plan's OP of 5,190m (revenue 46,900m), set before Kokoronet was consolidated. Underlying OP over the last four quarters is about 3.1bn (645+892+686+514, plus the 379m one-off in Q5), so a realistic guide including a full year of Kokoronet sits well below plan-plus-Kokoronet, and a formal mid-term plan cut is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last full-year print with new targets and a policy change (2025-05-08: earnings beat plus progressive dividend introduced): +14.14% the next session. The 17-month OP cut of 35% (2026-05-15) was bought at +2.42%. So guidance and policy news is where this name moves, in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: The gap between the plan and the run-rate is public, but how the company frames the new year is not: holding the mid-term plan, cutting it, or guiding a recovery. With 信用倍率 near 10, a guide below what holders expect has margin longs to sell into it. The stock at PBR 0.82, down from 1,595 a year ago, shows much of the weakness is held, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The May 2026 revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260515536333.pdf) blamed the cut on lower funeral counts from falling deaths, the same driver that weighs on FY2027.8. It is the same company, so not independent.

findings.finding: National deaths, the funeral-count driver, turned positive in July 2026: MHLW preliminary July deaths were 122,768, +2.9% YoY, after -1.8% in May and -1.1% in June, with Jan-Jul still -5.7%. This supports the company's 'excess-death hangover is transitional' narrative and a recovery-assuming FY2027.8 guide, and makes Jul-Aug funeral counts less weak than Q5's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance found of the stock reacting to this series. The company itself attributes its May cut and Q5 weakness to death counts in its areas.
findings.why_not_priced: A government vital-statistics PDF that this one-analyst-or-less small cap's holders are unlikely to track. A priced improvement would usually show as a rerating after the 09-25 release, but the stock has drifted from 1,365 to 1,337 since then. It is national rather than the company's Kanto/Kinki/Tohoku areas, so it is a proxy and sized small.
findings.independence: The company's own Q5 text (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260814/140120260814520221.pdf) expects demand to recover as the excess-death reaction fades. That is a different source pointing the same way.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns set a floor. The company runs a progressive dividend policy with '10期連続増配予定' and a 12-month equivalent of about 40 yen for the 17-month 57 yen, so the FY2027.8 dividend forecast should be at least about 40 yen (3.0% yield at 1,337). It targets 3bn+ of returns over the plan, and the May 2026 print came with a 500m buyback that completed on 2026-07-30, leaving room for another at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-05-08 (progressive dividend introduced): +14.14%. 2026-05-15 (buyback with the OP cut): +2.42% despite a 35% profit cut.
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public, so a 40-yen dividend is priced. Only an increase above about 40 yen or a new buyback would be news, and neither is knowable before the release, hence the skewed band and a small point estimate. If a buyback were expected, the stock would show the bid that held it near 1,400 through July. It fell back after the program ended.
findings.independence: Policy text in the mid-term plan (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250814/140120250814541516.pdf, 株主還元方針) and buyback completion (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260803/140120260803506444.pdf). These are company documents.

findings.finding: The non-consolidated subsidiary クニカネクスト overbilled health-insurance 療養費 from 2021 to Feb 2026, and refunds are under way. It could produce a small one-off below operating income in the full-year accounts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Disclosed 2026-07-07. No visible reaction in the daily closes around it.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July. It is non-consolidated and tiny next to a 32bn market cap, so it is almost certainly immaterial. It is filed because it is a sourced fact that bears on the accounts.

outside_window.finding: MHLW's August 2026 preliminary deaths (the second month of the stub) publish around late October, after the window. The company's Jul-Aug actuals land today anyway.

baseline_tension: Mildly agrees with the priced lean (-0.72, mostly margin overhang) and cuts against the +4.4% run-up. Strongest positive the release could carry: a FY2027.8 guide framed as a recovery with the full Kokoronet year, a dividend above 40 yen, or a new buyback. I looked; none is signalled, but the progressive-dividend policy and the July uptick in deaths make it live, which is why p_up sits at 48 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative that rests on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信 is held by the price): finding 1 trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2, and p_up moved from 46 to 48
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. I had already searched for returns and the guide, so it did not move p_up a second time
Findings 2 to 5 left standing: finding 2 is about what the release ADDS (the new-year guide), which rule 1 explicitly exempts
